objective: Kill 8 Nightbane Vile Fang and 8 Nightbane Tainted One worgen for Calor in Darkshire.

description: Your previous accomplishments have convinced me that you are ready to take on the toughest worgen infesting the woods.
Of the worgen that have made their new home here, the Vile Fangs and the Tainted Ones have proven the most dangerous. They've settled down near some of the caves and in the mine to the south.
From far away you can even see the light from their bonfires...
progress: Intimidating beasts aren't they? But have no fear, <name>, those who stand for the Light will never fall!
completion: <name>, to be honest with you, I did not believe that you would get this far, but you are clearly a <class> to be reckoned with. In fact, if you wish to formally join Master Carevin's struggle, I will gladly write for you a letter of recommendation.
